theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (τ : Fin 2 → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → Orthonormal ℝ τ → a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) → e ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = Q ∧ ∃ ε : ℤ, ε.natAbs = 1 ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) 2, α τ = (ε : ℝ) * α ![a, e]
